manifest.name: NightLife
manifest.description: Enables night sky on all official maps.

releases.release_notes_markdown:
- toggling between day/night with F8
- new maps (now covering all):
  ```
  TDM_Galencourt
  TDM_Falmire
  FFA_Falmire
  TDM_FrozenWreck
  FFA_FrozenWreck
  TO_Citadel
  TO_Montcrux
  FFA_Bazaar
  FFA_Duelyard
  ```
- minor fog adjustments (Stronghold and other)
- added loading widget
- maps will not be unloaded anymore, only made invisible
- PageUp/PageDn (+Shift) (fog rising) updated

Known issues: 
- Citadel: not all fires inside the city are shown
- Duelyard: brightness too high during warmup
- Bridgetown: Smoke behind initial tenosia spawn not transparent when switching back to day
